title: Anthropic has acquired the dev tools startup used by OpenAI, Google, and Cloudflare
summary: Anthropic acquired Stainless, a startup that automates the creation and maintenance of software development kits (SDKs) used by major AI players. This acquisition enhances Anthropic's development capabilities and potentially reduces development time and costs.
